approved: Build verified components only, "Verified components: a kanban board": the library doesn't cover this use case yet, so it is not built. You get a kanban board — working and verified, as separate components to add to your app. (ui.kanban.turbineh). Not included: Given a project exists, a user can create a task within that project; Given a task exists, a user can assign a specific team member to it; Given a task exists, a user can set a priority level for it; Given a task exists, a user can assign a due date to it; Given a task exists, a user can add a text comment to it; Given a task's due date has passed and it is not in the 'Done' column, the task is visually flagged as overdue; Given a user is logged in, the user can view a filtered list containing only tasks assigned to them; and the application itself (its screens, data and flows) — only these components. This package is not the complete product you described.
